```{r setup, message=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(forcats)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(hms)
library(quantreg)
library(splines)
library(broom)

# Parallel back-end --------------------------------------------------------

library(future)
library(future.apply)

# Use a reasonable number of workers.
# availableCores() respects system / RStudio limits and environment settings.
available <- future::availableCores()
workers <- max(1L, min(as.integer(available) - 1L, 8L))

plan(multisession, workers = workers)

print(workers)

# Define quantiles globally -----------------------------------------------

taus <- c(0.10, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 0.90)

# Helper to extract tidy coefficients from rq objects ---------------------

get_qr_coefs <- function(fit_model, taus_vec) {
  model_sum <- summary(fit_model, se = "nid", covariance = FALSE)
  
  dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(seq_along(taus_vec), function(i) {
    s  <- model_sum[[i]]
    tb <- as.data.frame(s$coefficients)
    tibble::tibble(
      term      = rownames(tb),
      tau       = taus_vec[i],
      estimate  = tb[, "Value"],
      std.error = tb[, "Std. Error"],
      p.value   = tb[, "Pr(>|t|)"]
    )
  })) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!grepl("^factor\\(Year\\)", term))
}
```

```{r}
# Load and clean data
df <- read.csv("NYC Marathon Results.csv",
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
               check.names = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    Year = as.integer(Year),
    Age  = as.integer(Age)
  ) %>%
  filter(Country == "USA") %>%
  mutate(
    `Year of Birth` = Year - Age,
    FinishSeconds   = as.numeric(as_hms(`Finish Time`)),
    Gender          = factor(Gender, levels = c("W", "M"))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(FinishSeconds), !is.na(Year), !is.na(Age), !is.na(Gender))
```

```{r}
### Model 1: Base Title IX (3-Level Factor) ###

# Create 3-level Title IX variable
df_m1 <- df %>%
  mutate(
    TitleIX = dplyr::case_when(
      Gender == "M" ~ "No",
      `Year of Birth` >= 1970 ~ "Yes",
      `Year of Birth` >= 1954 & `Year of Birth` <= 1969 ~ "Some",
      `Year of Birth` <= 1953 ~ "No",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    TitleIX = factor(TitleIX, levels = c("No", "Some", "Yes"))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(TitleIX))

qr_fit_base <- rq(
  FinishSeconds ~
    factor(Year) +
    bs(Age, knots = c(21, 45, 60)) +
    TitleIX +
    Gender +
    bs(Age, knots = c(21, 45, 60)) : Gender,
  tau   = taus,
  data  = df_m1,
  method = "fn"
)
```

```{r}
coef_base <- get_qr_coefs(qr_fit_base, taus)
print(coef_base)
```

```{r}
# Plot effects for "Some" and "Yes" vs "No"
plot_data_base <- coef_base %>%
  filter(term %in% c("TitleIXSome", "TitleIXYes")) %>%
  mutate(
    label      = fct_recode(term,
                            "Some vs No" = "TitleIXSome",
                            "Yes vs No"  = "TitleIXYes"),
    effect_min = estimate,
    lo         = (estimate - 1.96 * std.error),
    hi         = (estimate + 1.96 * std.error)
  )

print(plot_data_base)

ggplot(plot_data_base, aes(x = tau, y = effect_min, color = label, group = label)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi, fill = label), alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(x = "Quantile (tau)", y = "Effect on finish time (minutes)",
       title = "Estimated Title IX effect (Base Model)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

ggsave("someyesplot.png")
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)

# Plot effects for "Some" and "Yes" vs "No" — in **seconds**
plot_data_base <- coef_base %>%
  filter(term %in% c("TitleIXSome", "TitleIXYes")) %>%
  mutate(
    label     = fct_recode(term,
                           "Some vs No" = "TitleIXSome",
                           "Yes vs No"  = "TitleIXYes"),
    effect_sec = estimate,
    lo         = estimate - 1.96 * std.error,
    hi         = estimate + 1.96 * std.error
  )

ggplot(
  plot_data_base,
  aes(x = tau, y = effect_sec, color = label, group = label)
) +
  # 95% CI ribbons
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi, fill = label),
              alpha = 0.20, color = NA) +
  # lines
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  # reference line
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.6) +
  # x-axis as percent quantiles
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  # nicer legend title
  scale_color_discrete(name = "Title IX status") +
  scale_fill_discrete(name = "Title IX status") +
  labs(
    x = "Quantile (τ)",
    y = "Effect on finish time (seconds)",
    title = "Estimated Title IX effect (Base Model)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    plot.title   = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 22),
    axis.title   = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20),
    axis.text    = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 15, r = 20, b = 15, l = 20)
  )
```

```{r}
### Model 2: Continuous Exposure (0-17 Years) ###

# Map birth years to Title IX exposure duration (0-17 years)
df_m2 <- df %>%
  mutate(
    # Recreate the base variable for logic mapping
    TitleIX_Cat = dplyr::case_when(
      Gender == "M" ~ "No",
      `Year of Birth` >= 1970 ~ "Yes",
      `Year of Birth` >= 1954 & `Year of Birth` <= 1969 ~ "Some",
      TRUE ~ "No"
    ),
    TitleIX_years = dplyr::case_when(
      TitleIX_Cat == "No"   ~ 0,
      TitleIX_Cat == "Yes"  ~ 17,
      TitleIX_Cat == "Some" ~ pmin(pmax(`Year of Birth` - 1953, 1), 16),
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(TitleIX_years))

qr_fit_cont <- rq(
  FinishSeconds ~
    factor(Year) +
    bs(Age, knots = c(21, 45, 60)) +
    TitleIX_years +
    Gender +
    bs(Age, knots = c(21, 45, 60)) : Gender,
  tau   = taus,
  data  = df_m2,
  method = "fn"
)
```

```{r}
coef_cont <- get_qr_coefs(qr_fit_cont, taus)

# Print only the relevant continuous term
coef_cont %>%
  filter(term == "TitleIX_years") %>%
  print()
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

coef_cont_titleix <- coef_cont %>%
  filter(term == "TitleIX_years")

ggplot(coef_cont_titleix,

  # reference line at 0
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.6) +
  # 95% CI error bars
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = estimate - 1.96 * std.error,
                    ymax = estimate + 1.96 * std.error),
                width = 0.03,
                linewidth = 0.8) +
  # points and connecting line
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = coef_cont_titleix$tau) +
  labs(
    x = "Quantile (τ)",
    y = "Seconds (s)",
    title = "Coefficients for TitleIX_years, by Quantile"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    # Title & text
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 22),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20),
    axis.text  = element_text(size = 16),
    
    # Grid and panel tweaks
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    
    # Margins for breathing room on a poster
    plot.margin = margin(t = 15, r = 20, b = 15, l = 20)
  )

ggsave("continuous_plot.png")
```



```{r}
### Model 3: 18-Category Discrete (No, Some1-16, Yes) ###

# Create granular factor levels for every year of exposure
df_m3 <- df_m2 %>%
  mutate(
    TitleIX_years_disc = as.integer(TitleIX_years),
    TitleIX_18 = dplyr::case_when(
      TitleIX_years_disc == 0L  ~ "No",
      TitleIX_years_disc == 17L ~ "Yes",
      TitleIX_years_disc >= 1L & TitleIX_years_disc <= 16L ~ paste0("Some", TitleIX_years_disc),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    # Ensure correct ordering: No -> Some1...Some16 -> Yes
    TitleIX_18 = factor(TitleIX_18, levels = c("No", paste0("Some", 1:16), "Yes"))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(TitleIX_18))

qr_fit_18 <- rq(
  FinishSeconds ~
    factor(Year) +
    bs(Age, knots = c(21, 45, 60)) +
    TitleIX_18 +
    Gender +
    bs(Age, knots = c(21, 45, 60)) : Gender,
  tau   = taus,
  data  = df_m3,
  method = "fn"
)
```

```{r}
coef_18 <- get_qr_coefs(qr_fit_18, taus)
print(coef_18)
```

```{r}
# Plot effects by exposure year (x-axis) rather than quantile
plot_data_18 <- coef_18 %>%
  filter(grepl("^TitleIX_18Some|TitleIX_18Yes", term)) %>%
  mutate(
    exposure = dplyr::case_when(
      grepl("Some", term) ~ as.integer(str_remove(term, "^TitleIX_18Some")),
      grepl("Yes", term)  ~ 17L
    ),
    effect_min = estimate / 60
  )

ggplot(plot_data_18, aes(x = exposure, y = effect_min, color = factor(tau))) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:17, labels = c(as.character(1:16), "Yes")) +
  labs(x = "Exposure (Years)", y = "Effect vs No (minutes)",
       color = "Quantile", title = "Title IX effect by exposure duration") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

```{r}
### Model comparison via 5-fold CV (pinball loss)

# Check / pinball loss for a given tau

check_loss <- function(y, yhat, tau) {
u <- y - yhat
(tau - (u < 0)) * u
}

# K-fold CV for a given data + formula across all taus

cv_qr_mean_loss <- function(df, formula, taus_vec, K = 5) {
n     <- nrow(df)
folds <- sample(rep(1:K, length.out = n))

tau_losses <- vapply(taus_vec, function(tau) {
loss <- numeric(n)

for (k in seq_len(K)) {
  train_idx <- folds != k
  test_idx  <- folds == k
  
  fit_k <- rq(
    formula,
    tau    = tau,
    data   = df[train_idx, , drop = FALSE],
    method = "fn"
  )
  
  pred_k <- predict(fit_k, newdata = df[test_idx, , drop = FALSE])
  loss[test_idx] <- check_loss(df$FinishSeconds[test_idx], pred_k, tau)
}

mean(loss)

}, numeric(1))

mean(tau_losses)
}

set.seed(123)  # for reproducible folds (within each model)

# Extract formulas from the models you've already fit

form_m1 <- formula(qr_fit_base)
form_m2 <- formula(qr_fit_cont)
form_m3 <- formula(qr_fit_18)
form_m4 <- formula(qr_fit_since1975)
form_m5 <- formula(qr_fit_5)
form_m6 <- formula(qr_fit_4)

# Helper: run CV for one model

cv_one_model <- function(df, form, label) {
tibble::tibble(
model = label,
mean_check_loss = cv_qr_mean_loss(df, form, taus, K = 5)
)
}

# Launch six futures – each sees only its own df + form

f1 <- future::future(
cv_one_model(df_m1, form_m1, "M1: 3-level factor"),
packages = c("quantreg", "splines", "tibble")
)

f2 <- future::future(
cv_one_model(df_m2, form_m2, "M2: Continuous 0–17 yrs"),
packages = c("quantreg", "splines", "tibble")
)

f3 <- future::future(
cv_one_model(df_m3, form_m3, "M3: 18-level discrete"),
packages = c("quantreg", "splines", "tibble")
)

f4 <- future::future(
cv_one_model(df_m4, form_m4, "M4: Trend since 1975"),
packages = c("quantreg", "splines", "tibble")
)

f5 <- future::future(
cv_one_model(df_m5, form_m5, "M5: School stage (5-level)"),
packages = c("quantreg", "splines", "tibble")
)

f6 <- future::future(
cv_one_model(df_m6, form_m6, "M6: Generational cohorts (4-level)"),
packages = c("quantreg", "splines", "tibble")
)

# Collect results

cv_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(
future::value(f1),
future::value(f2),
future::value(f3),
future::value(f4),
future::value(f5),
future::value(f6)
) %>%
arrange(mean_check_loss)

cv_results
```

```{r}
# Optional: simple visualization of the ranking

cv_results %>%
  mutate(model = forcats::fct_reorder(model, mean_check_loss)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = model, y = mean_check_loss)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "5-fold mean check loss (lower is better)",
    title = "Cross-validated quantile loss by Title IX specification"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

```{r}
### Final Sample Size Calculation ###

# Calculate the total number of finishers (N)
N_total <- nrow(df)

# Calculate the number of women finishers (NW)
N_women <- df %>%
  filter(Gender == "W") %>%
  nrow()

# Print the results in the requested format
cat(
  "Final analytic sample: N=", N_total,
  "\nN=", N_total, " finishers, of which NW=", N_women,
  "\nNW = ", N_women, " women."
)
```
